title: Waiting on design: commodity search lists results as the trader types, in both animals sets, once commodities come from MDM
detail: The commodity search lists results as the trader types, behind an icon search button, announces results and selections in a polite live region, and keeps the typed text open for more ticks, with Escape closing the results. The 9 October afternoon ruling keeps today's server-side search, which already works without JavaScript, and holds this behaviour until design answers its question about search as you type; it is also held until commodities come from MDM. When both have happened it is built as design says with an accepted component, or dropped if design drops it. This is the live-animals half of the row; the germinal set's copy of the same behaviour is the germinal-products area's draft for it. The germinal commodity search is to list matching commodities as the trader types, each with its code and species, and announce the number of results. The behaviour waits twice over: on design's answer about search as you type, and on the germinal catalogue, which is drawn from the central commodity list. When both are settled it is built as design says, or dropped if design drops it.

openQuestions: Design must answer its question about commodity search as you type: build it as design says with an accepted component and no custom JavaScript copied from the prototype, or drop it if design drops it (ruling 2026-10-09 afternoon, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-059, -p2-008; c-012).

Blocked also until commodities come from MDM: whoever owns the MDM integration must make the MDM commodity list reach the animals frontend through trade-imports-reference-data, after which the area is re-distilled (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-060, -p2-008; c-278).

Blocked 20 Oct (Sam): waits for the MDM commodity API and the commodity type-ahead component: EUDPA-617 'Integrate early-access MDM commodity API into live animals frontend' (frontend to reference-data to MDM) and EUDPA-616 'Add a search type-ahead for choosing commodities, reusable across the journey' (the JavaScript type-ahead over the no-JavaScript search-then-tick fallback).

Design must answer whether the commodity search lists results as the trader types, and with which accepted component: built as design says, or dropped if design drops it (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-059; c-012).

Blocked also until the central commodity list reaches the animals frontend and the germinal catalogue is drawn from it, because these results are that catalogue (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-060; c-282).
notes: Combines the drafts of the commodities, germinal-products areas for this row: they change the same pages, record and journey, so building them apart would repeat the same set-up, review and ladder.

Combines the live-typing slice (req-072), the live-region slice (req-073) and the tick-and-Escape slice (req-074): one client-side behaviour on one page, none observable apart from the others. Kept apart from the MDM catalogue row because it carries a second blocker, design's unanswered question, that the catalogue does not. The existing row inc-014 also holds the germinal set's copy of this behaviour (req-1782, the germinal-products area's), so the combiner should keep inc-014's id, theme (waiting-on-design), gate, dependencies and its germinal criterion, and merge the germinal-products area's draft into it, as the 9 October afternoon ruling makes design's question one increment. Its external dependency on the commodities-and-reason search-results row (inc-013) stays. The prototype's whole list shipped with the page is not copied (c-012 outcome; its overruled claims are not named). A new client-side entry must be wired into the frontend's build, or it fails silently. Design snagging merged to main 23 Oct: the joined blue icon search button is now one shared macro, appSubmittedSearch, built from MoJ Search classes; build the last criterion by switching the commodity search page to it rather than with new markup, and reuse the bold-match helper for as-you-type results. Re-analysis 27 Oct (main checked at animals-frontend ba85c222 after EUDPA-617 c3183a8e): the block still applies in part. Design's question is unanswered. The live-animals half of the MDM block has gone, because the search now calls reference-data; the germinal half still waits. The EUDPA-616 branch predates EUDPA-617 and edits a file it deleted, so it needs rebasing; it carries no Escape handling, no results label and no 'options selected' announcement, and its own icon button duplicates main's shared macro.

existingRow inc-014, the waiting-on-design row that already holds this area's req-1782 beside the commodities area's live-animals half of the same behaviour (req-072, req-073, req-074). The combiner keeps inc-014's id, its waiting-on-design theme, its blocked status, its dependency on inc-016 and the criteria already there, and merges these germinal criteria in, as one increment for the search-as-you-type question. Kept apart from the germinal catalogue row (inc-191) because it carries a second blocker, design's answer, which the catalogue does not. The germinal criteria are written as conditionals because the behaviour exists only if design keeps it.
gate: Look at the as-you-type search with and without JavaScript, with a screen reader's announcements, before any other client-side component copies its pattern; check its script is in the built bundle on a fresh stack.
